question: How is the Lord of Serpents honored as sovereign of arts and time?
premises: Obeisance is offered to the supreme lord of arts and time.
The same deity is addressed as Lord of Serpents.
The salutation is repeated for reverence.
inference: Nāgeśa is revered as sovereign over arts and time.
uncertainties: The compound kalā-kala may admit alternative readings.
plain_english: Obeisance to the supreme lord of arts and time, obeisance, obeisance to Nāgeśa.
